title: NEXUS JARVIS_MINISTRAL_ROUTER_OUTPUT_V1
description: Structured interpretation produced by the local Ministral cognitive router for a single Jarvis message. This is an INTERPRETATION only - it never mutates anything itself. 'intent' deliberately reuses the same values as jarvis-message.schema.json's request_class so JarvisService can dispatch it through the exact same canonical methods classify() already uses. 'referenced_task_id' must be one of the candidate_task_ids given in the router's input context, or null - enforced both by the gateway (schema) and again by the Render-side caller (membership check) before anything is dispatched.
